description: List an owner EOA's Loopr positions with health, leverage and PnL. Requires chainId or chainIds. Pass positionAddress (with chainId, not chainIds) to fetch a single position: it returns `{ position, errors, catalogUnavailable }`, and a null `position` with `errors` rows means the chain could not be read, not that the position does not exist.
name: get_positions
title: Get positions
